WITH hof_by_state AS (
  SELECT 
    p.death_state,
    COUNT(*) AS hof_count
  FROM hall_of_fame hf
  INNER JOIN player p ON hf.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_state
),
state_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS overall_avg
  FROM hof_by_state
),
above_average_states AS (
  SELECT 
    hbs.death_state,
    hbs.hof_count,
    sa.overall_avg
  FROM hof_by_state hbs
  CROSS JOIN state_average sa
  WHERE hbs.hof_count > sa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(hof_count) AS avg_count,
  AVG(hof_count - overall_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM above_average_states;
